_comment_top: Default eval config — cos path (current search behavior).
_comment_usage: Pass via --eval_config <path>. When this file is used as-is, behavior is identical to omitting --eval_config (cos eval, expected_cos from --expected_cos).
_comment_template: To switch to end-to-end eval: change eval_metric to 'topx' / 'coco_mAP' / 'custom', set expected_acc + direction, and fill in the end-to-end fields below. See python/calibration/end2end_topx_example.py for a runnable reference.
_comment_eval_metric: cos | topx | coco_mAP | custom. cos = current intermediate-tensor comparison (default). topx/coco_mAP/custom = end-to-end task-level metric on final outputs.
_comment_direction: End-to-end/custom only (cos path infers per search mode: lower_better for threshold/sensitivity, higher_better for cluster). higher_better for top1/mAP/cos; lower_better for cos_loss/mse/perplexity.
_comment_expected_acc: End-to-end cluster-acceptance floor (Option B). When >0, used as the minimum acceptable metric (e.g. top1 >= 0.85 keeps demoting clusters to int4 until top1 drops below 0.85). When 0, falls back to target_cos_threshold (cos-based, baseline*expected_cos). The GT/baseline for the cos path is still computed as before (FP32 ref tensors on calibration set); this only affects the end2end cluster-acceptance judge.
_comment_metric_index: End-to-end only. Which tuple element of score.get_result() to use (topx returns (top1, top5); 0=top1, 1=top5).
_comment_use_end2end_in_search: End-to-end only. When true, threshold tuning + sensitivity sweep + op-type sensitivity + adjust_qtable + round eval also use end2end as the decision metric. When false (default), only the cluster-acceptance loop uses end2end; all other decision points use cos. Set to true to fully drive the search by end2end accuracy.
_comment_sample_num: End-to-end only. Samples per trial. 0 = use mix_prec.num_sample (calibration set size). Recommend small (e.g. 50) for search; full dataset for final validation.
_comment_e2e_section: === End-to-end / custom fields below — ignored when eval_metric == 'cos' ===
_comment_score_plugin: End-to-end only. Name of base_class subclass in eval/postprocess_and_score_calc/. Shorthand: defaults to eval_metric when not set (topx -> topx).
_comment_score_plugin_args: End-to-end only. Passed to the plugin's init() (e.g. topx reads label_file). Add any plugin-specific fields here. NOTE: batch_size here is a plugin hint only — the ACTUAL inference batch size is derived from the model (MlirParser.get_batch_size(), usually 1 for search models) and overrides this value. Set the model's batch size at model_transform time, not here.
_comment_input_source: End-to-end only. 'calibration' = reuse ref_activations (fast, needs parallel labels); 'full' = re-preprocess dataset per sample (slow, exact, matches model_eval.py).
_comment_dataset: End-to-end only, input_source='full'. Dataset root directory (e.g. /data/imagenet/val).
_comment_data_list: End-to-end only, input_source='full'. Optional image list file.
_comment_postprocess_type: End-to-end only. Mirrors model_eval.py's --postprocess_type. Shorthand: defaults to score_plugin when not set.
_comment_eval_func: Custom path only (eval_metric='custom'). 'path/to/file.py::func_name' — fn(outputs, gt, idx, ctx) -> float. See python/calibration/end2end_topx_example.py docstring for the template.
_comment_gt_provider: Custom path only. Optional 'path/to/file.py::func_name' — fn(idx) -> label. When null, the score plugin reads --label_file directly.
